routes.label: Calculate the ratio using the radii

question: The diameters of two circles are \(8\) inches and \(12\) inches respectively. The ratio of the area of the smaller to the area of the larger circle is:
solution:
A radius is half its diameter, so the smaller and larger circles have radii 4 inches and 6 inches. Using the circle area formula \(A=\pi r^2\), their smaller-to-larger area ratio is
\[
\frac{\pi\cdot4^2}{\pi\cdot6^2}
=\frac{16}{36}=\frac49.
\]
The common factor \(\pi\) cancels because we are comparing the two areas. The answer is \(4/9\), choice B.
